name: fix_node_secrets_in_logs
description: Fixes a logger that serializes secrets (password, Authorization header, apiKey) into the access log
prompts: formatLog(event) in logger.js serializes a request event for the access log by dumping the whole object with JSON.stringify - so secrets like the password field and the Authorization header end up in the logs. Fix formatLog to redact sensitive values: any property whose key is (case-insensitively) one of password, token, authorization, secret, or apiKey must have its value replaced with the string "[REDACTED]", INCLUDING keys nested inside sub-objects (e.g. event.headers.authorization). All non-sensitive fields must be preserved unchanged. Return the JSON string of the redacted object. Keep the module export and the formatLog(event) signature.
